item.subject: science
item.chapter_label: The night sky: Moon and calendars
item.stem: Meena places a straight stick upright on her school playground in Jaipur and marks the tip of its shadow every half hour from morning to evening, for two days in a row. Her teacher says she can use her readings to measure the length of one day, which is nearly 24 hours. Which method should Meena use?

options.A: Measure the time between the stick's longest shadow on the first day and its longest shadow on the second day.
options.B: Measure the time between the Sun's highest position (shortest shadow) on the first day and the Sun's highest position on the second day.
options.C: Measure the time from sunrise to sunset on a single day and double it.
options.D: Count the total number of shadow marks she makes between morning and evening on one day.
